findings.title: Recheck the cache after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: Concurrent non-development calls can all observe an empty cache at lines 41–43 and then wait here. After the first call loads and caches the manifest, each waiter still proceeds to load it again because the cache is not rechecked under the lock. A burst of requests during startup therefore causes redundant manifest reads and cache replacements; recheck the cache after acquiring the lock and return it when populated.
